description: This file defines the InputContentFile class, which extends StaticContentFile and adds an InputStream field with getter and setter methods for handling content files in the system.

classes.name: InputContentFile
classes.description: A model class representing an input content file with a stream of data, extending StaticContentFile.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the InputStream representing the file content.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the InputStream for the file content.
